justification: Changes how the page-map gate reads a running header, which decides whether a whole DCP chapter can be extracted. Standard: one function family, text parsing only, no DB access; every extracted rule still goes to the review queue.

pre_impl.existing_data: pdfplumber page text of the Waverley DCP 2022 file we serve (R2 v1.1-2026-03-16, 448 pages) and the council's Amendment 6 (493 pages, downloaded by hand 2026-11-10)
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Amendment 6 prints 'Transport B7' on one line; the gate expected 'B7' alone, matched 28 of 493 pages and refused the chapter
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Runs at extraction time only, for councils in HEADER_DERIVED_COUNCILS

functions.name: page_headers
functions.input: the pdfplumber text of every page in the chapter PDF
functions.output: {page: (code, title)} for pages with a running header
functions.if_none: page absent from the dict; under 50% coverage derive_ranges_from_headers returns [] and the chapter is refused

values.guard_at: counted only if repeated on 3 pages or listed with the same first title word in the document's contents
values.if_missing: page has no header; ranges skip it

break_it.scenario: A one-off first line 'Refer to the controls in Part E1'
break_it.what_happens: Not repeated and not in the contents under that title: ignored

break_it.scenario: Colour table line 'Olive Mist green G54' on line 2 of a page (real, previous Waverley file p160)
break_it.what_happens: Titled form allowed on the first line only: ignored

break_it.scenario: A wrong titled header slips through anyway
break_it.what_happens: Its code either resumes after another part or leaves a numbering gap, both of which refuse the chapter; otherwise the rules go to dcp_review_queue for a person
break_it.how: existing resume and gap refusals; review mode

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Old gate code restored: 2 failed; first-line limit removed: 1 failed
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Ran the new tests against HEAD~ gate and a loosened gate: 2 and 1 failures respectively

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - re-run Waverley Amendment 6 intake and dcp_extract_changed.py --review; expect 32 parts derived
